Penpot | Open-source design and prototyping platform for teams

summary.one_liner: Penpot is an open-source, web-based design and prototyping platform for product teams, designed to be self-hosted or used in the browser.
summary.what_it_does: Penpot is a design platform that runs in the browser or on your own servers, with real-time collaboration for teams. It works with open standards such as SVG, CSS, HTML, and JSON, and its inspect tab provides SVG, CSS, and HTML code for designs. It includes native Design Tokens, Components, and Variants for managing design systems, plus CSS Grid and Flex Layout for responsive designs. The README also describes a plugin system, an open API with access tokens, webhooks, and an MCP server for design-to-code and AI-driven workflows. A paid Penpot Enterprise plan adds an Admin Console and SSO for multi-team governance.
use_cases: design and prototyping for product teams
managing design systems with design tokens
exporting SVG, CSS, or HTML from designs
automating design workflows through an API or plugins
how_to_run: Install with Docker, Kubernetes, Elestio, or other options described on the project website
Or use the hosted SaaS version
notable: Self-hostable and deployment agnostic, with a hosted SaaS option
Design is expressed as code, with SVG, CSS, HTML, and JSON output via an inspect tab
Native design tokens, components, and variants for design systems
MCP server and open API/plugin system for automation and AI workflows
CSS Grid and Flex Layout support for responsive designs
caveats: Penpot Enterprise is a paid plan for admin console, advanced permissions, and SSO
The README gives no specific system requirements for self-hosting
Detailed installation steps are on the external website, not in the README
